title: Navratri Celebration
summary: The Rotary Club of Bombay Northwest – Malad organised a vibrant Navratri Celebration, bringing members together to celebrate the festive spirit with joy and enthusiasm.
description: The Rotary Club of Bombay Northwest – Malad organised a vibrant Navratri Celebration, bringing members together to celebrate the festive spirit with joy and enthusiasm. The event was filled with music, dance, and traditional festivities, promoting togetherness, cultural values, and stronger bonds of friendship among members.
